set.body: Introduce typed DesignColumnSelector and TermSelector APIs over DesignColumnDescriptor/DesignColumnMeta. Replace export term selection paths that infer by string prefix with descriptor-based selection while preserving compatibility fallbacks. Acceptance: eventPlotData/design exports can select by term, role, condition, basis, and run; tests prove renamed columns still select correctly.
set.title: Design: semantic column selectors for exports and colmap
